locations: Peninsula west of the Crafting Guild
notes: NPC ids 3049/3050/3286/3287/3288/3289 (level 28 unarmed, 29 xp); an armed level-42 form (49 xp) also exists.
29 Hitpoints, Defence 24, max hit 3, 4-tick melee (unarmed crush; armed form is stab, 6-tick).
All defensive bonuses are +0, so any melee style is equally accurate; no elemental weakness.
The God Wars Dungeon hobgoblin (npc 2241) is a separate spawn not counted here.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 292 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Hobgoblins is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.

Authored as Mazchna-only (30-50, weight 7) per the C3 starter-tier worklist. The live wiki ALSO lists Vannaka as an assigner; that is documented here and can be folded in later as an additive masterIds/amount/weight edit if desired (same decision as cockatrice/pyrefiends).
No Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Mazchna's combat-level threshold is around 20.
Two forms count: the level-28 unarmed hobgoblin and the level-42 armed hobgoblin; the default variant pins the level-28 form.
All defensive bonuses are +0, so any melee style clears them; there is no elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null).
recommendedMethod: Hobgoblins are a low-level Mazchna task in the Edgeville Dungeon and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. They have Defence 24 with all defensive bonuses +0, so any melee weapon is equally accurate - bring your best melee setup and a Slayer helmet. They hit up to 3 with melee, so minimal food is needed. Both the unarmed level-28 and armed level-42 forms count toward the task.
